    # Load scored samples (keep existing SN, Quality, Confidence)
    scored = load_jsonl(OUTPUT_DIR / "scored_samples.jsonl")
    print(f"Loaded {len(scored)} scored samples")

    # Extract texts
    synthetic_texts = extract_assistant_texts(scored)

    # Load gen-0 corpus
    data_splits = load_dataset_splits(DATA_DIR)
    gen0_texts = extract_assistant_texts(data_splits["train"])
    print(f"Gen-0 corpus: {len(gen0_texts)} texts")

    # Build TF-IDF on gen-0 corpus
    print("Building TF-IDF vectorizer on gen-0 corpus...")
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=10000, stop_words="english")
    corpus_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(gen0_texts)

    # Compute TF-IDF cosine LC for each synthetic sample
    print("Computing TF-IDF cosine LC...")
    random.seed(42)
    k = 50
    lc_tfidf_scores = []
    for i, s in enumerate(synthetic_texts):
        s_tfidf = vectorizer.transform([s])
        ref_indices = random.sample(range(len(gen0_texts)), min(k, len(gen0_texts)))
        ref_tfidf = corpus_tfidf[ref_indices]
        cos_sims = cosine_similarity(s_tfidf, ref_tfidf)[0]
        lc_tfidf_scores.append(float(np.mean(cos_sims)))
        if (i + 1) % 1000 == 0:
            print(f"  LC scored {i+1}/{len(synthetic_texts)}")

    # Gather all scores
    sn_scores = [s["scores"]["semantic_novelty"] for s in scored]
    quality_scores = [s["scores"]["quality"] for s in scored]
    confidence_scores = [s["scores"]["confidence"] for s in scored]
    lc_bleu_scores = [s["scores"]["lexical_conformity"] for s in scored]

    arrays = {
        "lexical_conformity": np.array(lc_tfidf_scores),
        "semantic_novelty": np.array(sn_scores),
        "quality": np.array(quality_scores),
        "confidence": np.array(confidence_scores),
    }

    # Stats
    print("\n=== TF-IDF Cosine LC Stats ===")
    lc_arr = arrays["lexical_conformity"]
    print(f"  mean={lc_arr.mean():.4f}, std={lc_arr.std():.4f}, min={lc_arr.min():.4f}, max={lc_arr.max():.4f}")

    # Correlation matrix
    properties = ["lexical_conformity", "semantic_novelty", "quality", "confidence"]
    print("\n=== Pearson Correlation (TF-IDF cosine LC) ===")
    pearson_results = {}
    for i, p1 in enumerate(properties):
        for j, p2 in enumerate(properties):
            if i < j:

                print(f"  {key}: r={r:.4f} (p={p:.2e})")

    spearman_results = {}
    for i, p1 in enumerate(properties):
        for j, p2 in enumerate(properties):
            if i < j:
                key = f"{p1}_vs_{p2}"
                rho, p = stats.spearmanr(arrays[p1], arrays[p2])
                spearman_results[key] = round(rho, 4)
                print(f"  {key}: rho={rho:.4f} (p={p:.2e})")

    # Judgment
    max_pearson = max(abs(v) for v in pearson_results.values())
    max_spearman = max(abs(v) for v in spearman_results.values())
    lc_conf_pearson = abs(pearson_results["lexical_conformity_vs_confidence"])
    lc_conf_spearman = abs(spearman_results["lexical_conformity_vs_confidence"])

    pass_07 = max_pearson < 0.7 and max_spearman < 0.7
    pass_05 = lc_conf_pearson < 0.5 and lc_conf_spearman < 0.5
    overall = pass_07 and pass_05

    print(f"  |rho|_max (Spearman): {max_spearman:.4f}")
    print(f"  LC vs Conf |r| (Pearson): {lc_conf_pearson:.4f}")
    print(f"  LC vs Conf |rho| (Spearman): {lc_conf_spearman:.4f}")
    print(f"  All pairs |r| < 0.7: {'PASS' if pass_07 else 'FAIL'}")
    print(f"  LC vs Confidence < 0.5: {'PASS' if pass_05 else 'FAIL'}")
    print(f"  OVERALL: {'PASS' if overall else 'FAIL'}")

    # Compare with BLEU-4
    print(f"\n=== BLEU-4 vs TF-IDF Cosine Comparison ===")
    bleu_corr = stats.pearsonr(lc_bleu_scores, lc_tfidf_scores)
    print(f"  BLEU-4 LC vs TF-IDF LC correlation: r={bleu_corr[0]:.4f}")
    print(f"  BLEU-4 |r|_max was: 0.303 (original Phase 0)")
    print(f"  TF-IDF |r|_max is:  {max_pearson:.4f}")

    # Original BLEU-4 correlations for comparison
    print(f"\n=== Side-by-side: LC correlations (Pearson) ===")
    orig_bleu = {"lc_vs_sn": -0.117, "lc_vs_quality": -0.0475, "lc_vs_confidence": 0.3028}
    for key_short, orig_r in orig_bleu.items():

                            .replace("lc_vs_quality", "lexical_conformity_vs_quality") \
                            .replace("lc_vs_confidence", "lexical_conformity_vs_confidence")
        new_r = pearson_results[full_key]
        print(f"  {full_key}: BLEU-4={orig_r:.4f} -> TF-IDF={new_r:.4f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
